scenes.heading: Set a caseload you can actually sustain

sents.d: Set a caseload you can actually sustain
There is a number of sessions a week you can run and stay sharp. Find it before you pass it.
Past your limit, notes get short and follow ups get missed.
The clients who suffer first are the ones who booked you before you got busy.

scenes.heading: Cap it and keep a waitlist

sents.d: Track your sessions for two weeks and note how sharp you felt by the last one.
Set that number as your maximum in your booking tool, then start a waitlist.

take: Find your sustainable session count, then cap it and keep a waitlist.
